name: Tsinghua University  -  Mathematics Department and Qiuzhen College
header:
Tsinghua University - Mathematics
Department and Qiuzhen College
China · Doctoral Mathematics: Department of Mathematical Sciences (042) and Qiuzhen College (476). Both are explicitly on the
2027 list accepting international applicants directly from a bachelor's degree. Qiuzhen: five years from bachelor's, four from
master's. An overseas bachelor's route for Chinese nationals is separate and had July 2026 deadlines.
Selected Asian research destination. Department 042 Mathematics and department 476 Qiuzhen College are distinct doctoral
application choices; their deadlines, language and selection rules must not be combined.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Citizenship is decisive. F-1 status does not establish eligibility for the international route. Chinese nationals
with overseas bachelor's degrees have a separate domestic route, whose published 2027 deadlines at both
Mathematics and Qiuzhen were July 28, 2026.
• Qiuzhen's international scholarship-priority application deadline is November 27, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time.
Its second round closes April 2, 2027 at 17:00; that is not the stated Chinese Government Scholarship round.
• Qiuzhen expects clear support from at least one potential faculty member and uses three separate
three-hour written examinations followed by an interview. These are substantial preparation requirements.
• The 2027 international Mathematics Department catalogue detail could not be retrieved. Do not transfer
Qiuzhen's English waiver, deadlines or examinations to department 042.
• Scholarship amounts, any guaranteed multi-year Qiuzhen package, reference invitation mechanics and
response deadlines must be confirmed. The central 2027 scholarship instructions remain pending; 2026 CSC
document rules are historical preparation evidence.
• Faculty listed below are official dissertation advisers or current affiliated researchers; this does not certify a
2027 opening or availability under both application codes.
• Qiuzhen's adviser pages retain departed faculty: Yu-Wei Fan moved to SIMIS/Fudan in 2025; Yongxiong Li's
current BIMSA profile ends Tsinghua employment in 2024. Their entries are flagged and not treated as normal
current Tsinghua openings.
• The Mathematics Department audit and Qiuzhen/YMSC audit are combined below, with joint appointments
deduplicated by name. The list preserves external-adviser possibilities and departed-faculty cautions
separately from ordinary current Tsinghua appointments.
• No professor's presence on a faculty list establishes availability to supervise an international applicant in
2027. The domestic doctoral directory is a useful route-specific check, not a substitute for international
admission rules.
• Recent-paper checks are unresolved for Hechun Zhang, Minxian Zhu, Shenghao Sun, Ziqun Lu, Jing Yang and
Guowu Yao; verified older examples are explicitly dated. Do not infer inactivity, retirement or a 2027 vacancy
from this evidence gap.
• Shenghao Sun's English profile heading and employment text disagree on rank; current Chinese profile says
associate professor.
• Jing Yang and Guowu Yao have current Teaching Center appointments; present as adjacent contacts, not
confirmed doctoral advisers.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Non-Chinese applicant: a recognized bachelor's degree permits direct PhD application to both 042 Mathematics
and 476 Qiuzhen, subject to programme review, language and nationality documentation. Final-year students
may apply with expected-graduation evidence but must obtain and authenticate the degree by registration.
UChicago supplies the appropriate degree category, not automatic admission. International applicants formerly
holding Chinese nationality normally require foreign nationality for at least six years by April 30, 2027; special
birth/parent-residence evidence applies. Chinese-national overseas bachelor's applicants: both 2027 domestic
guides explicitly admit candidates from leading overseas universities with GPA normally at least 3.5/4; these
applications had a separate, now-closed July window. Citizenship, GPA, graduation date and nationality history
remain necessary inputs. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s16] [s17]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Determine nationality route and department code first; obtain degree/enrolment, transcript, GPA and
nationality documents, English-medium certificate or test, two eligible referees, statement and research plan.
Qiuzhen expects clear support from a potential supervisor during selection, but does not state that it must be
secured before initial submission; early contact is prudent. Submit online documents and fee. Qiuzhen
shortlists after document review, then requires three independently proctored written tests of three hours each
and an online interview of at least 30 minutes; select one primary research-area examination (50%) and two
others (25% each) from eight subject areas. Its algebra/number-theory examination includes algebraic
geometry and representation theory. Domestic DMS instead requires two adviser-selected examinations
totalling three hours and an approximately 30-minute interview, with equal written/interview weighting. Do not
apply this domestic rule to DMS international admissions. [s1] [s4] [s18] [s17]
Adviser contact [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen expects clear support from at least one potential faculty member, although the formal thesis adviser
is selected later. Its algebra/number-theory/representation contacts are Koji Shimizu
(shimizu@tsinghua.edu.cn) and William Donovan (donovan@tsinghua.edu.cn); programme contact
qzsy@tsinghua.edu.cn. DMS international listing gives sec-math@tsinghua.edu.cn and
ymsc_academics@tsinghua.edu.cn; its domestic guide strongly advises discussing direction and examinations
with an intended supervisor before application. Confirm the admission code under which each person can
supervise and 2027 availability. The 2027 Qiuzhen curriculum names YMSC, BIMSA and the Morningside Center
as potential adviser institutions after qualifying examinations; external affiliations therefore require
route-specific confirmation rather than automatic exclusion. [s4] [s7] [s17] [s20]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
International application portal https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin. Two programme choices are sequential:
submit the first; a second choice becomes available only if not admitted to the first. Complete statement fields,
upload documents and pay; application status is checked online. Detailed letter-status/update mechanics,
file-size limits and exact statement prompts are not publicly available. The public catalogue is dynamic and the
042 detail returned no usable data during this audit. [s1] [s6] [s8]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Central international, direct-bachelor's, tuition and Qiuzhen application pages explicitly concern 2027. Qiuzhen
round 1 is open on November 5, 2026. Chinese-national 2027 programme guides are also current but their July
windows are closed. Central scholarship page still labels the 2027 instructions as coming soon; CSC/AFLSP
materials presently linked concern 2026 and are not 2027 deadlines. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s11] [s14] [s16] [s17]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen international round 1: September 28, 2026 at 08:00 to November 27, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time;
round 2: January 4, 2027 at 08:00 to April 2, 2027 at 17:00. The 042 Mathematics international deadline is
unresolved because its dynamic catalogue detail was not accessible. Chinese-national overseas-bachelor's
route at BOTH Qiuzhen and Mathematics: July 1, 2026 at 10:00 to July 28, 2026 at 15:00, already closed; no
later window verified. [s4] [s8] [s16] [s17]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen applicants seeking Chinese Government Scholarship consideration must apply in round 1, by
November 27, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time. This programme-specific cutoff precedes the central general
recommendation to apply by mid-December. The separate 2027 CSC Type A/Type B submission and
nomination deadlines have not been published on the checked scholarship pages; Type A depends on the
relevant national authority. Qiuzhen internal scholarship and Beijing/Tsinghua tuition-award deadlines are not
independently specified. Do not roll forward 2026 dates. [s4] [s6] [s11] [s12]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
For Qiuzhen, plan for a complete file by the applicable round deadline: November 27, 2026 or April 2, 2027 at
17:00 Beijing time. No separate public international referee deadline or grace period was verified. Domestic
guides require referees to complete/upload within the system's specified time; their application window ended
July 28, 2026 at 15:00. Later original-letter mailing dates are notification-specific. [s1] [s4] [s16] [s17]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
Qiuzhen requires English evidence or an eligible English-medium degree certificate in the application. No
distinct score-receipt grace period or official reporting-code rule was found: meet the selected round deadline.
DMS international language and score cutoffs remain unverified. Domestic guides requested English proof
during the July application window. [s1] [s4] [s8] [s16] [s17]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Upload the required file and pay within the selected application round. Nationality documents must be
complete by the department's deadline: no later supplements are accepted for that requirement. Graduates
need degree authentication in the application; final-year candidates need expected-graduation evidence and
final diploma/authentication by 2027 registration. No universal international hard-copy mailing cutoff is
published in the checked guide. Central verification is slower during January 21-February 17, 2027 winter
break; the university recommends submitting two to three weeks early. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal 2027 offer-acceptance, deposit or funding-commitment date verified. Qiuzhen says decisions are
normally issued within a month after a round ends; this is a decision timetable, not an acceptance deadline.
Follow the individual offer and scholarship instructions. [s4] [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen: IELTS overall 6.5, TOEFL overall 80 for tests before January 21, 2026 or 4.5 on/after that date, another
comparable authoritative score, or certification that a completed bachelor's/master's programme was entirely
taught in English. Qiuzhen does not require HSK. These are programme-specific: DMS 042 international
English/Chinese rules remain unverified in its inaccessible catalogue detail. Domestic Chinese-national guides
request CET-4/CET-6 or other English test evidence, without a published UChicago waiver or numerical
minimum. [s4] [s1] [s8] [s16] [s17]
UChicago English exemption [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen explicitly accepts a bachelor's or master's degree taught entirely in English, supported by the
awarding institution's certificate. A completed UChicago English-medium degree fits this route if the certificate

confirms the entire programme; obtain that proof. Because the wording refers to an obtained degree, a
final-year applicant should confirm whether expected completion plus an English-medium letter suffices before
the application deadline. Do not assume the same exemption for 042 Mathematics or the Chinese-national
route. [s4] [s16] [s17]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Neither the central 2027 direct-doctoral requirements nor Qiuzhen's current application list requires or
recommends GRE General. This is absence from the published requirements, not evidence that scores are
forbidden or ignored. DMS 042's programme-specific status remains unverified. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s8]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No GRE Mathematics requirement or recommendation is stated for Qiuzhen or in the central direct-doctoral
guide; permission to upload unsolicited scores is not publicly verified. Qiuzhen instead has its own substantial
written examinations. DMS international-specific policy remains unresolved. [s2] [s4] [s8]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [2027 confirmed]
International application: complete academic transcripts, degree/diploma or final-year expected-graduation
certificate, and degree authentication where already graduated. If the transcript omits overall GPA, supply a
university-issued GPA certificate. Scan original/notarized documents IN COLOUR with a scanner: photographs,
camera/phone captures and scans of photocopies are not accepted. Documents must be Chinese/English or
accompanied by notarized translations. Qiuzhen specifically requests English transcripts. Final-year final
degree and authentication are due by registration. Chinese-national overseas-bachelor's candidates
additionally use the domestic forms and CSCSE foreign-degree authentication; master-specific document lines
in the combined domestic checklist need clarification for bachelor's-only applicants. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s16] [s17]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separately prescribed mathematics-course list was located in the international central/Qiuzhen checklist.
The transcript is required. DMS 042 may impose additional items in its unavailable catalogue/portal; confirm
rather than treating this as an exclusion. [s1] [s4] [s8]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate course-description or syllabus upload requirement was identified in the checked international
guides. Do not confuse Qiuzhen's entrance-examination syllabi with an applicant course-description
requirement. Portal and DMS-specific supplements remain unverified. [s1] [s4] [s18]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
International direct PhD: two recommendation letters from associate professors or professors, and the
direct-bachelor's guide expressly requires them to attest to the applicant's suitability for direct doctoral study.
Qiuzhen says at least two academic referees of associate-professor rank or higher, or equivalent academic
seniority. Use two qualifying academic writers; additional-letter capacity is unverified. The separate
Chinese-national route also requires two relevant associate-professor-or-higher/equivalent experts. [s1] [s2] [s4]
[s16] [s17]
Scholarship references [Prior cycle]
The 2027 CSC checklist is pending. Tsinghua's 2026 CSC attachment required two
professor/associate-professor letters addressing the applicant's China-study goals, abilities and future
development and any institutional/supervisor cooperation. These are scholarship-specific questions; no third
letter is specified, but reuse of the admission letters is not established. AFLSP's separate extra reference is for
master's applicants and is not a doctoral funding route. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s19]

What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
International guide requires online recommendations but does not publicly identify whether entering/saving a
referee, clicking a separate invitation button, or application submission sends the email. Do not import rules
from Tsinghua undergraduate or MBA systems. The domestic guide explicitly says the applicant invites two
experts online; it does not specify the exact UI event. [s1] [s2] [s16] [s17]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
No verified public rule establishes that international reference invitations wait until final submission or may be
sent earlier. Confirm in the actual graduate portal before relying on a late submission. Domestic online
invitation is described separately, without a submission dependency. [s1] [s16] [s17]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The application portal supports applicant status checking, but a letter-specific received indicator/email
confirmation was not documented in the public sources checked. Confirm each referee's completion through
the portal or graduate office; do not equate a sent invitation with receipt. [s1] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
International letter replacement, referee editing after submission and cross-cycle/cross-programme reuse are
not publicly verified. Domestic writers must retain originals and later send them as instructed, or seal them
with signatures across the flap for applicant delivery. That domestic paper procedure is not established for the
international route. [s1] [s16] [s17]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
No separately labelled CV appears in the checked central 2027 international or Qiuzhen list. Whether the live
portal requires one remains unverified; there is no public exact prompt, length or format rule. Prepare a factual
academic CV for adviser contact but do not label it a proven mandatory upload. [s1] [s4]
Statement of purpose [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen explicitly requires an English statement of purpose. The central international application also asks for
a personal statement in the application system. Public pages do not publish the exact Qiuzhen prompt,
word/page limit, font or formatting rules, nor establish whether these are one shared portal field or distinct
submissions; confirm before drafting final versions. [s1] [s4] [s5]
Personal / background statement [2027 confirmed]
Central international 2027 requirement: a personal statement completed in the application system; exact
prompt and limit are not public in the checked guide. No separate personal-background/diversity essay is
identified. Domestic recommendation-exempt statement prompts cover academic background, research
undertaken, academic interests, graduate study/research plans, other strengths and relevant information;
these are not automatically the overseas-bachelor's ordinary-application prompt. [s1] [s16] [s17]
Research-interest statement [2027 confirmed]
International doctoral applicants must upload a brief account of research experience or research plan, in
addition to completing the statement fields. No independent research-interest essay with a separate limit was
verified. Relate interests to potential Qiuzhen faculty and examination field. Exact upload type/length/format
remain portal-dependent. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Research proposal [2027 confirmed]
Central doctoral application asks for a brief research-experience statement or research plan; a fully specified
long proposal is not prescribed publicly. Historical 2026 CSC scholarship application separately required a
study plan exceeding 1,000 words/characters in Chinese or English, signed by a Chinese supervisor for doctoral
candidates; reconfirm for 2027. Qiuzhen's formal thesis proposal in year 4 of the bachelor's-entry programme
is a degree milestone, not this admission requirement. [s1] [s4] [s13]

Writing sample / thesis / research summary [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen permits research papers, publications and other original work as optional supporting materials for
committee review. No required undergraduate thesis, writing sample, exact length or citation-only prohibition
is published. The public wording concerns submitted materials; a URL-only replacement is not verified.
Domestic DMS ordinary applicants submit a research summary describing a current master's thesis or
completed thesis/results; how this is adapted to its overseas-bachelor's route needs confirmation. [s4] [s17]
Publications list [Unresolved]
Optional published/research work may strengthen the Qiuzhen file; no publication prerequisite or separate
mandatory publications list is stated. Number, size, full-paper upload versus link and formatting limits are not
publicly specified. Follow the live portal, and distinguish optional articles from the central required short
research account. [s4] [s1]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No standalone mathematics-course-list writing/upload prompt found. Transcript/GPA evidence remains
mandatory. Any portal-only or department 042 list requirement is unresolved. [s1] [s4] [s8]
Scholarship essays [Prior cycle]
2027 scholarship-specific prompts are not yet published. Historical 2026 CSC: separate CSC application,
study/research plan over 1,000 words/characters (Chinese or English) with Chinese-supervisor signature for
PhD, and two letters addressing scholarship criteria. The checklist also requires pre-admission evidence and
identity, degree, transcript, language, health and criminal-record documents. No additional published Qiuzhen
scholarship essay prompt was found. AFLSP's English PDF/video/extra letter concerns master's candidates only
and is not applicable to the doctoral routes here. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s19]
Other short answers / materials [2027 confirmed]
International: passport and nationality-history evidence, application-system entries and authenticated
academic documents. The 2026 CSC checklist additionally requested a foreigner physical-examination form
completed in English with required doctor/hospital seals and normally a non-criminal record, both generally

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen describes three scholarship levels and says its minimum level covers tuition and standard living costs,
but gives no numerical stipend or guaranteed award. Standard full CSC coverage for 2027/28 includes doctoral
stipend RMB 3,500/month (RMB 42,000/year if paid for 12 months), tuition, accommodation/subsidy and
insurance; this is an award standard, not automatic Tsinghua funding. Beijing/Tsinghua tuition scholarships
may cover full/partial tuition, usually not living expenses. The 2027 tuition schedule lists Qiuzhen doctoral
Mathematics and general science doctorates at RMB 40,000/year. Obtain a written package separating cash,
tuition and housing. [s4] [s10] [s14] [s15]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Qiuzhen bachelor's-entry PhD lasts five years, master's-entry four. A guaranteed internal scholarship duration
is not public. The 2026 CSC guide states doctoral awards normally cover four to five years subject to annual
review; 2027 award terms must confirm the entire intended programme. Beijing/Tsinghua tuition awards
generally last one academic year, with further competitive application/renewal. [s4] [s10] [s12]
International eligibility [Prior cycle]
The international scholarship routes are for qualifying non-Chinese nationals. The 2026 CSC notice explicitly
permits eligible bachelor's-to-PhD applicants through Type A or Type B and generally requires doctoral
applicants to be under 40; 2027 criteria are pending. A U.S. F-1 visa does not establish nationality eligibility or

the appropriate Type A embassy. Chinese-national candidates use separate domestic funding rules, for which
no numerical guarantee was verified. [s4] [s12] [s16] [s17]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
CSC normally requires annual academic review and prohibits concurrent incompatible
Chinese-government/university awards; Type B needs department pre-admission/recommendation before
university nomination and CSC selection. Qiuzhen states its scholarships cannot be held simultaneously with
another scholarship. Tuition awards are competitive and usually annual. Assistantships require separate
duties/appointments. Admission alone is not evidence of full funding. [s4] [s10] [s12]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
For CSC: complete the academic application first/in parallel as instructed; Type A applies through the relevant
national dispatching authority, Type B requires departmental pre-admission/recommendation and a separate
CSC-system application, then university nomination. Meet Qiuzhen's first-round deadline for consideration.
Exact 2027 CSC form deadlines and Qiuzhen internal-award selection/application mechanism remain
unpublished. Historical CSC document and supervisor-signature requirements should be prepared early. [s4]
[s11] [s12] [s13]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Potential sources include CSC Type A and Type B, Beijing Government/Tsinghua tuition scholarships, Qiuzhen
scholarships, teaching/research/administrative assistantships and later enrolled-student merit awards. Rates
and compatibility require written confirmation. AFLSP 2026 is explicitly for non-Chinese Asian master's
students, so it should not be counted as available doctoral funding. [s4] [s10] [s12] [s19]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International application fee RMB 800, paid online with the application, nonrefundable. CSC does not cover the
application fee. The fee for the separate domestic Chinese-national route was not verified from the programme
guides and must not be assumed to be RMB 800. [s9] [s12] [s16] [s17]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No public international fee waiver or financial-hardship waiver process was verified. The fee page calls the RMB
800 payment nonrefundable; scholarship application does not itself waive it. Confirm with graduate admissions
if seeking an exception. [s9] [s12]

Vertex operator algebras, conformal blocks, tensor categories, conformal nets and operator-algebraic

Theorems

arXiv:2606.30928.
Representation theory

Vertex operator algebras, affine Lie (super)algebras and Virasoro representations, braided tensor categories
and logarithmic conformal field theory. [s63] [s64]
YMSC associate professor since 2026; current Qiuzhen adviser profile confirms rank.

Representations of algebras, derived and triangulated categories, cluster tilting and silting. [d1]
Professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences.
Research evidence: 2025 · Mutation graph of support τ-tilting modules over a skew-gentle algebra
Official profile lists this 2025 Forum of Mathematics Sigma article.
Fan Xu
Hall algebras, triangulated categories and quantum cluster algebras, including positivity for surface cluster
variables. [d2] [d3]
Associate professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences.
Research evidence: 2026 journal publication; 2024 preprint revised April 2026 · Quantum cluster variables via canonical
submodules
Primary author paper opened; DOI 10.1016/j.jalgebra.2025.11.014 linked from arXiv. Department bibliography is older, ending
2020.
Hechun Zhang
Lie theory, quantum groups/supergroups, canonical bases and invariant theory. [d4] [d5]
Professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences; doctoral adviser in current profile.
Research evidence: 2020 · First fundamental theorems of invariant theory for quantum supergroups
Latest verified article in official selected bibliography; more recent original-paper evidence remains unresolved. Avoid attributing
papers by same-name younger researchers.

Representation theory of algebras, Ringel-Hall algebras, quivers, weighted projective lines and quantum
groups. [d6] [d7]
Professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences; doctoral adviser.

Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Primitive elements in Ringel-Hall algebras of tame hereditary algebras
Primary arXiv abstract and current institutional profile both opened.
Ziqun Lu
Finite groups, linear algebraic groups of Lie type, modular characters and blocks. [d19] [d20]
Associate professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences / Teaching Center of Mathematics.
Research evidence: 2022 · On Huppert’s ρ-σ conjecture for blocks
Institutional coauthor repository confirms 2022 Archiv der Mathematik paper. No 2024-2026 original paper verified.
Representation theory and mathematical physics
Nicolai Reshetikhin
Quantum groups and their representations, quantum topology, classical/quantum integrable systems, KZ
equations and Poisson geometry. [s65]

employment through 2021. Older YMSC biography is stale.

With Andrii Liashyk and Ivan Sechin; Communications in Mathematical Physics 407(1), 15.
Research evidence: 2025 · Foams and KZ-equations in Rozansky-Witten theories
With Sergei Gukov and Babak Haghighat; Nuclear Physics B, 116856.
Hao Zheng
Fusion and higher categories, quantum groups, topological orders, categorification and low-dimensional
topology. [s66]

Research evidence: 2024 · Categories of quantum liquids II
With Liang Kong; Communications in Mathematical Physics 405(9), 203.
Research evidence: 2023 · Categorical computation
With Liang Kong; Frontiers of Physics 18, 21302.

Supersymmetric/conformal field theory and its geometric representation-theory connections, affine vertex
algebras and their associated varieties. [s67] [s68] [s33]

With Peng Shan and Qixian Zhao; arXiv:2606.08990.

With Shan and Zhao; arXiv:2507.09254.

Arithmetic of elliptic curves, special L-values, Iwasawa theory and complex multiplication. [s69] [s70]

With Li-Tong Deng, Yukako Kezuka and Meng Fai Lim; Journal of the Australian Mathematical Society 120(2), 183-217.
Research evidence: 2025 · Non-vanishing of central L-values of the Gross family of elliptic curves
With Yukako Kezuka; Journal of the London Mathematical Society 111(6).

Calabi-Yau categories and manifolds, stability conditions, derived automorphisms, mirror symmetry and
categorical dynamics. [s71] [s72]
Qiuzhen's adviser listing is stale: author identifies SIMIS/Fudan joint associate professorship from 2025 and Tsinghua

Science China Mathematics (2026), per author.

enumerative geometry. [d8] [d9]

Toric Calabi-Yau geometry, open Gromov-Witten invariants, mirror symmetry, topological recursion and
Frobenius structures. [d10] [d11]

Vertex operator algebras, affine and Virasoro representations, quantum groups and periods of Calabi-Yau
hypersurfaces. [d14]
Associate professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences.
Research evidence: 2021 · On the hyperplane conjecture for periods of Calabi-Yau hypersurfaces in P^n

Stability conditions, Calabi-Yau and Fukaya categories, braid and mapping-class groups, cluster theory, and

Positivity of nef classes, Hodge index and hard Lefschetz phenomena, intersection theory, Kähler and

Associate professor with Department of Mathematical Sciences and YMSC affiliation.

Arithmetic algebraic geometry, étale cohomology and algebraic stacks. [d17] [d18]
Department of Mathematical Sciences; Chinese profile and English employment history say associate professor, but English

Moduli of Riemann surfaces, Teichmüller theory, Weil-Petersson geometry, hyperbolic surfaces and spectral
geometry. [d22]
Professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences and YMSC since 2023.

Singularities, Bernstein-Sato polynomials, jet schemes, Tjurina algebras, associated Lie algebras and CR

schemes.

Jiayan Yao (Jia-Yan Yao)
Transcendence in positive characteristic, function-field and p-adic number theory, automatic sequences and
arithmetic dynamics. [d25] [d26] [d34]
Professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences.

Algebraic number theory and coding-theory applications; recent listed work emphasizes teaching and a 2023
algebraic-number-theory textbook. [d27] [d28]

Independent PhD supervision for 2027 not verified.

Quasiconformal mappings, Beltrami differentials and infinite-dimensional Teichmüller spaces. [d29]

Latest article in current official bibliography is 2020; 2024-2026 original-paper evidence remains unresolved.

Integrable hierarchies, Frobenius manifolds, FJRW and cohomological field theories, Hodge integrals and
mirror-symmetry connections. [d30] [d31]
Professor and doctoral adviser, Department of Mathematical Sciences since December 2015.
Research evidence: 2026 · The extended Ablowitz-Ladik hierarchy and a generalized Frobenius manifold
Coauthor Youjin Zhang's current official bibliography lists the 2026 Communications in Mathematical Physics article with Si-Qi Liu
and Yuewei Wang.

Frobenius manifolds, Gromov-Witten and Hodge-integral connections, integrable systems and Virasoro
symmetries. [d30]
Professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences; current profile confirms 2026 teaching.

Official bibliography lists this 2026 article and several 2025-2026 papers on Frobenius manifolds. Adjacent fit for enumerative
geometry, not a claim of general AG supervision.

Dan Xie
Vertex and W-algebras, Hitchin moduli, mirror symmetry, symplectic duality and algebraic geometry arising
from supersymmetric field theory. [d32] [d33]
Tenured professor at Tsinghua since November 2018; DMS faculty profile.
Research evidence: 2026 · Mirror symmetry for circle compactified 4d N = 2 SCFTs
Primary journal publication May 4, 2026, with Peng Shan and Wenbin Yan; abstract directly identifies VOA representations and
Hitchin/Coulomb-branch geometry.

Zhuo Chen
Deformation theory of complex structures, Lie algebroids and Lie pairs, homotopy and derived Poisson
geometry, quantum groups and groupoids. [d35] [d36] [d37]
Associate professor, Department of Mathematical Sciences; distinct from the same-name Tsinghua astrophysicist.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · Infinitesimal deformations of Lie algebroid pairs
Primary paper of December 3, 2025, describes deformation theory recovering complex structures and transversely holomorphic
foliations.
Research evidence: 2024 · The Weak Graded Lie 2-Algebra of Multiplicative Forms on a Quasi-Poisson Groupoid
Primary publisher confirms June 23, 2024; current department profile independently lists the article.

Complex/differential geometry and its algebraic interfaces; recent work includes Hodge and Schubert-class
rigidity, sheaf moduli and enumerative geometry. [s4] [s22]

With Yuxiang Liu and Artan Sheshmani; arXiv:2603.25456 listed on coauthor's institutional bibliography.
Research evidence: 2026 · Rigid Schubert classes in partial flag varieties
With Yuxiang Liu and Artan Sheshmani; institutional bibliography records acceptance by Journal of Differential Geometry in 2026.

Enumerative and derived algebraic geometry, sheaf/curve moduli, Donaldson-Thomas and Gromov-Witten

With Jianping Wang and Xiaopeng Xia; arXiv:2606.17505.

With A. Malter; institutional bibliography records 2026 acceptance by Journal of Non-commutative Geometry.

China · Doctoral Mathematics: Department of Mathematical Sciences (042) and Qiuzhen College (476). Both are explicitly on the
2027 list accepting international applicants directly from a bachelor's degree. Qiuzhen: five years from bachelor's, four from
master's. An overseas bachelor's route for Chinese nationals is separate and had July 2026 deadlines.
Selected Asian research destination. Department 042 Mathematics and department 476 Qiuzhen College are distinct doctoral
application choices; their deadlines, language and selection rules must not be combined.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Citizenship is decisive. F-1 status does not establish eligibility for the international route. Chinese nationals
with overseas bachelor's degrees have a separate domestic route, whose published 2027 deadlines at both
Mathematics and Qiuzhen were July 28, 2026.
• Qiuzhen's international scholarship-priority application deadline is November 27, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time.
Its second round closes April 2, 2027 at 17:00; that is not the stated Chinese Government Scholarship round.
• Qiuzhen expects clear support from at least one potential faculty member and uses three separate
three-hour written examinations followed by an interview. These are substantial preparation requirements.
• The 2027 international Mathematics Department catalogue detail could not be retrieved. Do not transfer
Qiuzhen's English waiver, deadlines or examinations to department 042.
• Scholarship amounts, any guaranteed multi-year Qiuzhen package, reference invitation mechanics and
response deadlines must be confirmed. The central 2027 scholarship instructions remain pending; 2026 CSC
document rules are historical preparation evidence.
• Faculty listed below are official dissertation advisers or current affiliated researchers; this does not certify a
2027 opening or availability under both application codes.
• Qiuzhen's adviser pages retain departed faculty: Yu-Wei Fan moved to SIMIS/Fudan in 2025; Yongxiong Li's
current BIMSA profile ends Tsinghua employment in 2024. Their entries are flagged and not treated as normal
current Tsinghua openings.
• The Mathematics Department audit and Qiuzhen/YMSC audit are combined below, with joint appointments
deduplicated by name. The list preserves external-adviser possibilities and departed-faculty cautions
separately from ordinary current Tsinghua appointments.
• No professor's presence on a faculty list establishes availability to supervise an international applicant in
2027. The domestic doctoral directory is a useful route-specific check, not a substitute for international
admission rules.
• Recent-paper checks are unresolved for Hechun Zhang, Minxian Zhu, Shenghao Sun, Ziqun Lu, Jing Yang and
Guowu Yao; verified older examples are explicitly dated. Do not infer inactivity, retirement or a 2027 vacancy
from this evidence gap.
• Shenghao Sun's English profile heading and employment text disagree on rank; current Chinese profile says
associate professor.
• Jing Yang and Guowu Yao have current Teaching Center appointments; present as adjacent contacts, not
confirmed doctoral advisers.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Non-Chinese applicant: a recognized bachelor's degree permits direct PhD application to both 042 Mathematics
and 476 Qiuzhen, subject to programme review, language and nationality documentation. Final-year students
may apply with expected-graduation evidence but must obtain and authenticate the degree by registration.
UChicago supplies the appropriate degree category, not automatic admission. International applicants formerly
holding Chinese nationality normally require foreign nationality for at least six years by April 30, 2027; special
birth/parent-residence evidence applies. Chinese-national overseas bachelor's applicants: both 2027 domestic
guides explicitly admit candidates from leading overseas universities with GPA normally at least 3.5/4; these
applications had a separate, now-closed July window. Citizenship, GPA, graduation date and nationality history
remain necessary inputs. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s16] [s17]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Determine nationality route and department code first; obtain degree/enrolment, transcript, GPA and
nationality documents, English-medium certificate or test, two eligible referees, statement and research plan.
Qiuzhen expects clear support from a potential supervisor during selection, but does not state that it must be
secured before initial submission; early contact is prudent. Submit online documents and fee. Qiuzhen
shortlists after document review, then requires three independently proctored written tests of three hours each
and an online interview of at least 30 minutes; select one primary research-area examination (50%) and two
others (25% each) from eight subject areas. Its algebra/number-theory examination includes algebraic
geometry and representation theory. Domestic DMS instead requires two adviser-selected examinations
totalling three hours and an approximately 30-minute interview, with equal written/interview weighting. Do not
apply this domestic rule to DMS international admissions. [s1] [s4] [s18] [s17]
Adviser contact [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen expects clear support from at least one potential faculty member, although the formal thesis adviser
is selected later. Its algebra/number-theory/representation contacts are Koji Shimizu
(shimizu@tsinghua.edu.cn) and William Donovan (donovan@tsinghua.edu.cn); programme contact
qzsy@tsinghua.edu.cn. DMS international listing gives sec-math@tsinghua.edu.cn and
ymsc_academics@tsinghua.edu.cn; its domestic guide strongly advises discussing direction and examinations
with an intended supervisor before application. Confirm the admission code under which each person can
supervise and 2027 availability. The 2027 Qiuzhen curriculum names YMSC, BIMSA and the Morningside Center
as potential adviser institutions after qualifying examinations; external affiliations therefore require
route-specific confirmation rather than automatic exclusion. [s4] [s7] [s17] [s20]

International application portal https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin. Two programme choices are sequential:
submit the first; a second choice becomes available only if not admitted to the first. Complete statement fields,
upload documents and pay; application status is checked online. Detailed letter-status/update mechanics,
file-size limits and exact statement prompts are not publicly available. The public catalogue is dynamic and the
042 detail returned no usable data during this audit. [s1] [s6] [s8]

Tsinghua University - Mathematics
Department and Qiuzhen College
China · Doctoral Mathematics: Department of Mathematical Sciences (042) and Qiuzhen College (476). Both are explicitly on the
2027 list accepting international applicants directly from a bachelor's degree. Qiuzhen: five years from bachelor's, four from
master's. An overseas bachelor's route for Chinese nationals is separate and had July 2026 deadlines.
Selected Asian research destination. Department 042 Mathematics and department 476 Qiuzhen College are distinct doctoral
application choices; their deadlines, language and selection rules must not be combined.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Citizenship is decisive. F-1 status does not establish eligibility for the international route. Chinese nationals
with overseas bachelor's degrees have a separate domestic route, whose published 2027 deadlines at both
Mathematics and Qiuzhen were July 28, 2026.
• Qiuzhen's international scholarship-priority application deadline is November 27, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time.
Its second round closes April 2, 2027 at 17:00; that is not the stated Chinese Government Scholarship round.
• Qiuzhen expects clear support from at least one potential faculty member and uses three separate
three-hour written examinations followed by an interview. These are substantial preparation requirements.
• The 2027 international Mathematics Department catalogue detail could not be retrieved. Do not transfer
Qiuzhen's English waiver, deadlines or examinations to department 042.
• Scholarship amounts, any guaranteed multi-year Qiuzhen package, reference invitation mechanics and
response deadlines must be confirmed. The central 2027 scholarship instructions remain pending; 2026 CSC
document rules are historical preparation evidence.
• Faculty listed below are official dissertation advisers or current affiliated researchers; this does not certify a
2027 opening or availability under both application codes.
• Qiuzhen's adviser pages retain departed faculty: Yu-Wei Fan moved to SIMIS/Fudan in 2025; Yongxiong Li's
current BIMSA profile ends Tsinghua employment in 2024. Their entries are flagged and not treated as normal
current Tsinghua openings.
• The Mathematics Department audit and Qiuzhen/YMSC audit are combined below, with joint appointments
deduplicated by name. The list preserves external-adviser possibilities and departed-faculty cautions
separately from ordinary current Tsinghua appointments.
• No professor's presence on a faculty list establishes availability to supervise an international applicant in
2027. The domestic doctoral directory is a useful route-specific check, not a substitute for international
admission rules.
• Recent-paper checks are unresolved for Hechun Zhang, Minxian Zhu, Shenghao Sun, Ziqun Lu, Jing Yang and
Guowu Yao; verified older examples are explicitly dated. Do not infer inactivity, retirement or a 2027 vacancy
from this evidence gap.
• Shenghao Sun's English profile heading and employment text disagree on rank; current Chinese profile says
associate professor.
• Jing Yang and Guowu Yao have current Teaching Center appointments; present as adjacent contacts, not
confirmed doctoral advisers.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Non-Chinese applicant: a recognized bachelor's degree permits direct PhD application to both 042 Mathematics
and 476 Qiuzhen, subject to programme review, language and nationality documentation. Final-year students
may apply with expected-graduation evidence but must obtain and authenticate the degree by registration.
UChicago supplies the appropriate degree category, not automatic admission. International applicants formerly
holding Chinese nationality normally require foreign nationality for at least six years by April 30, 2027; special
birth/parent-residence evidence applies. Chinese-national overseas bachelor's applicants: both 2027 domestic
guides explicitly admit candidates from leading overseas universities with GPA normally at least 3.5/4; these
applications had a separate, now-closed July window. Citizenship, GPA, graduation date and nationality history
remain necessary inputs. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s16] [s17]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Determine nationality route and department code first; obtain degree/enrolment, transcript, GPA and
nationality documents, English-medium certificate or test, two eligible referees, statement and research plan.
Qiuzhen expects clear support from a potential supervisor during selection, but does not state that it must be
secured before initial submission; early contact is prudent. Submit online documents and fee. Qiuzhen
shortlists after document review, then requires three independently proctored written tests of three hours each
and an online interview of at least 30 minutes; select one primary research-area examination (50%) and two
others (25% each) from eight subject areas. Its algebra/number-theory examination includes algebraic
geometry and representation theory. Domestic DMS instead requires two adviser-selected examinations
totalling three hours and an approximately 30-minute interview, with equal written/interview weighting. Do not
apply this domestic rule to DMS international admissions. [s1] [s4] [s18] [s17]
Adviser contact [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen expects clear support from at least one potential faculty member, although the formal thesis adviser
is selected later. Its algebra/number-theory/representation contacts are Koji Shimizu
(shimizu@tsinghua.edu.cn) and William Donovan (donovan@tsinghua.edu.cn); programme contact
qzsy@tsinghua.edu.cn. DMS international listing gives sec-math@tsinghua.edu.cn and
ymsc_academics@tsinghua.edu.cn; its domestic guide strongly advises discussing direction and examinations
with an intended supervisor before application. Confirm the admission code under which each person can
supervise and 2027 availability. The 2027 Qiuzhen curriculum names YMSC, BIMSA and the Morningside Center
as potential adviser institutions after qualifying examinations; external affiliations therefore require
route-specific confirmation rather than automatic exclusion. [s4] [s7] [s17] [s20]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
International application portal https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin. Two programme choices are sequential:
submit the first; a second choice becomes available only if not admitted to the first. Complete statement fields,
upload documents and pay; application status is checked online. Detailed letter-status/update mechanics,
file-size limits and exact statement prompts are not publicly available. The public catalogue is dynamic and the
042 detail returned no usable data during this audit. [s1] [s6] [s8]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Central international, direct-bachelor's, tuition and Qiuzhen application pages explicitly concern 2027. Qiuzhen
round 1 is open on November 5, 2026. Chinese-national 2027 programme guides are also current but their July
windows are closed. Central scholarship page still labels the 2027 instructions as coming soon; CSC/AFLSP
materials presently linked concern 2026 and are not 2027 deadlines. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s11] [s14] [s16] [s17]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen international round 1: September 28, 2026 at 08:00 to November 27, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time;
round 2: January 4, 2027 at 08:00 to April 2, 2027 at 17:00. The 042 Mathematics international deadline is
unresolved because its dynamic catalogue detail was not accessible. Chinese-national overseas-bachelor's
route at BOTH Qiuzhen and Mathematics: July 1, 2026 at 10:00 to July 28, 2026 at 15:00, already closed; no
later window verified. [s4] [s8] [s16] [s17]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen applicants seeking Chinese Government Scholarship consideration must apply in round 1, by
November 27, 2026 at 17:00 Beijing time. This programme-specific cutoff precedes the central general
recommendation to apply by mid-December. The separate 2027 CSC Type A/Type B submission and
nomination deadlines have not been published on the checked scholarship pages; Type A depends on the
relevant national authority. Qiuzhen internal scholarship and Beijing/Tsinghua tuition-award deadlines are not
independently specified. Do not roll forward 2026 dates. [s4] [s6] [s11] [s12]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
For Qiuzhen, plan for a complete file by the applicable round deadline: November 27, 2026 or April 2, 2027 at
17:00 Beijing time. No separate public international referee deadline or grace period was verified. Domestic
guides require referees to complete/upload within the system's specified time; their application window ended
July 28, 2026 at 15:00. Later original-letter mailing dates are notification-specific. [s1] [s4] [s16] [s17]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
Qiuzhen requires English evidence or an eligible English-medium degree certificate in the application. No
distinct score-receipt grace period or official reporting-code rule was found: meet the selected round deadline.
DMS international language and score cutoffs remain unverified. Domestic guides requested English proof
during the July application window. [s1] [s4] [s8] [s16] [s17]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Upload the required file and pay within the selected application round. Nationality documents must be
complete by the department's deadline: no later supplements are accepted for that requirement. Graduates
need degree authentication in the application; final-year candidates need expected-graduation evidence and
final diploma/authentication by 2027 registration. No universal international hard-copy mailing cutoff is
published in the checked guide. Central verification is slower during January 21-February 17, 2027 winter
break; the university recommends submitting two to three weeks early. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal 2027 offer-acceptance, deposit or funding-commitment date verified. Qiuzhen says decisions are
normally issued within a month after a round ends; this is a decision timetable, not an acceptance deadline.
Follow the individual offer and scholarship instructions. [s4] [s1]
English and GRE
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen: IELTS overall 6.5, TOEFL overall 80 for tests before January 21, 2026 or 4.5 on/after that date, another
comparable authoritative score, or certification that a completed bachelor's/master's programme was entirely
taught in English. Qiuzhen does not require HSK. These are programme-specific: DMS 042 international
English/Chinese rules remain unverified in its inaccessible catalogue detail. Domestic Chinese-national guides
request CET-4/CET-6 or other English test evidence, without a published UChicago waiver or numerical
minimum. [s4] [s1] [s8] [s16] [s17]
UChicago English exemption [2027 confirmed]
Qiuzhen explicitly accepts a bachelor's or master's degree taught entirely in English, supported by the
awarding institution's certificate. A completed UChicago English-medium degree fits this route if the certificate

confirms the entire programme; obtain that proof. Because the wording refers to an obtained degree, a
final-year applicant should confirm whether expected completion plus an English-medium letter suffices before
the application deadline. Do not assume the same exemption for 042 Mathematics or the Chinese-national
route. [s4] [s16] [s17]
GRE General [Unresolved]
Neither the central 2027 direct-doctoral requirements nor Qiuzhen's current application list requires or
recommends GRE General. This is absence from the published requirements, not evidence that scores are
forbidden or ignored. DMS 042's programme-specific status remains unverified. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s8]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
No GRE Mathematics requirement or recommendation is stated for Qiuzhen or in the central direct-doctoral
guide; permission to upload unsolicited scores is not publicly verified. Qiuzhen instead has its own substantial
written examinations. DMS international-specific policy remains unresolved. [s2] [s4] [s8]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [2027 confirmed]
International application: complete academic transcripts, degree/diploma or final-year expected-graduation
certificate, and degree authentication where already graduated. If the transcript omits overall GPA, supply a
university-issued GPA certificate. Scan original/notarized documents IN COLOUR with a scanner: photographs,
camera/phone captures and scans of photocopies are not accepted. Documents must be Chinese/English or
accompanied by notarized translations. Qiuzhen specifically requests English transcripts. Final-year final
degree and authentication are due by registration. Chinese-national overseas-bachelor's candidates
additionally use the domestic forms and CSCSE foreign-degree authentication; master-specific document lines
in the combined domestic checklist need clarification for bachelor's-only applicants. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s16] [s17]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separately prescribed mathematics-course list was located in the international central/Qiuzhen checklist.
The transcript is required. DMS 042 may impose additional items in its unavailable catalogue/portal; confirm
rather than treating this as an exclusion. [s1] [s4] [s8]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate course-description or syllabus upload requirement was identified in the checked international
guides. Do not confuse Qiuzhen's entrance-examination syllabi with an applicant course-description
requirement. Portal and DMS-specific supplements remain unverified. [s1] [s4] [s18]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
International direct PhD: two recommendation letters from associate professors or professors, and the
direct-bachelor's guide expressly requires them to attest to the applicant's suitability for direct doctoral study.
Qiuzhen says at least two academic referees of associate-professor rank or higher, or equivalent academic
seniority. Use two qualifying academic writers; additional-letter capacity is unverified. The separate
Chinese-national route also requires two relevant associate-professor-or-higher/equivalent experts. [s1] [s2] [s4]
[s16] [s17]
Scholarship references [Prior cycle]
The 2027 CSC checklist is pending. Tsinghua's 2026 CSC attachment required two
professor/associate-professor letters addressing the applicant's China-study goals, abilities and future
development and any institutional/supervisor cooperation. These are scholarship-specific questions; no third
letter is specified, but reuse of the admission letters is not established. AFLSP's separate extra reference is for
master's applicants and is not a doctoral funding route. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s19]

What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
International guide requires online recommendations but does not publicly identify whether entering/saving a
referee, clicking a separate invitation button, or application submission sends the email. Do not import rules
from Tsinghua undergraduate or MBA systems. The domestic guide explicitly says the applicant invites two
experts online; it does not specify the exact UI event. [s1] [s2] [s16] [s17]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
No verified public rule establishes that international reference invitations wait until final submission or may be
sent earlier. Confirm in the actual graduate portal before relying on a late submission. Domestic online
invitation is described separately, without a submission dependency. [s1] [s16] [s17]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
The application portal supports applicant status checking, but a letter-specific received indicator/email
confirmation was not documented in the public sources checked. Confirm each referee's completion through
the portal or graduate office; do not equate a sent invitation with receipt. [s1] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
International letter replacement, referee editing after submission and cross-cycle/cross-programme reuse are
not publicly verified. Domestic writers must retain originals and later send them as instructed, or seal them
with signatures across the flap for applicant delivery. That domestic paper procedure is not established for the
international route. [s1] [s16] [s17]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
No separately labelled CV appears in the checked central 2027 international or Qiuzhen list. Whether the live
portal requires one remains unverified; there is no public exact prompt, length or format rule. Prepare a factual
academic CV for adviser contact but do not label it a proven mandatory upload. [s1] [s4]
Statement of purpose [2027 confirmed]
